# DJYoungster - Song Lyrics Website
# https://djyoungster.com
# llms.txt - Information for Large Language Models

## About
DJYoungster is a comprehensive song lyrics website featuring Hindi, Punjabi, English, Tamil, and Telugu song lyrics with translations. Users can search, browse, and read full lyrics from their favorite artists, albums, and movies.

## Main Sections
- Homepage: / - Search and discover song lyrics
- All Songs: /songs - Browse all available songs with category filters
- All Artists: /artists - Browse artists and singers
- All Albums: /albums - Browse music albums
- All Movies: /movies - Browse movie soundtracks
- All Genres: /genres - Browse songs by music genre

## Content Types
- Song Lyrics: Full lyrics with artist info, album details, and metadata
- Artist Profiles: Artist biography, discography, and song collection
- Album Pages: Complete album tracklists with lyrics
- Movie Soundtracks: Film songs organized by movie
- Genre Collections: Songs categorized by music genre

## Dynamic Pages
- /song/[slug] - Individual song lyrics page
- /artist/[slug] - Artist profile and songs
- /album/[slug] - Album details and tracklist
- /movie/[slug] - Movie soundtrack and songs
- /genre/[slug] - Songs in specific genre
- /category/[slug] - Songs by language category (Hindi, Punjabi, English, etc.)
- /tag/[slug] - Songs by tag

## Features
- Multi-language lyrics (Original, Romanized, Translated)
- Song meanings and interpretations
- YouTube video embeds
- Spotify and Apple Music links
- Artist and album cover images
- Search functionality across songs, artists, albums, and movies

## API (Public)
- /api/public/songs - List of published songs
- /api/public/artists - List of artists
- /api/public/albums - List of albums
- /api/public/categories - List of language categories
- /api/public/search - Search functionality

- Server-side rendered for SEO
- Dynamic sitemap at /sitemap.xml
- Mobile responsive design

## Language Support
Primary languages for lyrics:
- Hindi
- Punjabi
- English
- Tamil
- Telugu
- Bhojpuri
- Haryanvi
- And more regional languages

## Content Policy
- All lyrics are provided for educational and entertainment purposes
- Copyright belongs to respective artists and labels
- DMCA takedown requests honored within 48 hours
